correctness.rationale: Pass for the stated layered update, with the corrected literature attribution in repairs/5/RESULT.md and the scope stated explicitly in the replacement slogan. The physical field is F_p, while p^a is the spatial period. A unit vector is cyclic for the spatial shift, so setting z=S-1 identifies its module with F_p[z]/(z^L). The neighborhood sum is z^(p-1) by the polynomial geometric-sum identity in characteristic p, not division by a singular operator. Adding p-1 to exponents gives one chain of length q+1 (residue 0) and p-2 of length q; these lengths are positive for a>=1 and sum to L. On k copies of any one spatial chain of length ell, the last k-1 rows of the memory map shift layers and the first row is T0 on their sum. The companion identity M^k=T0(I+M+...+M^(k-1)) follows by iterating the recurrence on each layer; the operators commute, so raising it to ell proves nilpotence there. Its kernel consists exactly of last-layer vectors in the one-dimensional spatial kernel, hence the memory restriction is one Jordan block of dimension k ell. This also covers k=1 and leaves just one block when p=2. Summation of max(k ell-t,0) yields all image ranks, with matching formulas at kq and zero first at k(q+1). Kernel sizes p^(kL-rank) give the histogram and the last-step fraction follows from rank one at tau-1. The 17 stated finite exact-field cases were read in the frozen script and recorded output, not executed; the analytic chain/kernel argument establishes the unbounded result. The replacement does not equate the stated update with an additional-delay rule, or attribute a printed combined-case bound to Endo where the inspected text states separate bounds.
